{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders: look for any revenue value >= 999999.00
qa_candidates = df[df['revenue_clean'] >= 999999.00]

# Print the number and values of potential QA orders
print(f"Number of potential QA orders (revenue >= 999999.00): {len(qa_candidates)}")
print(f"Values of potential QA orders: {qa_candidates['revenue_clean'].values}")

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue and count
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()
num_orders = len(loyal_completed)

# Print the results
print(f"Number of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {num_orders}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
